audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict their own why text, and the diff enum says EVEN while diffRating, tone (#ff5d6c) and breakdown.difficulty all say hard 8/10.
audit.why: whys[0] says Level 1 is contested 'evenly' but the row reads Neeko; whys[2] calls Level 3 'genuinely coin-flip' but the row reads Yasuo; whys[5] says your first item peaks your pick pressure but the row reads Yasuo. The packet chart [Skill, Yasuo, Skill, Yasuo, Neeko, Neeko, Yasuo] matches the prose on all four. Win rate 48.39% over 31 games — the largest sample in this slice and consistent with a hard lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 to the packet values as one atomic pair-matched group, and diff EVEN to HARD to agree with the 8/10 already on the page.

audit.why: Four spikes: Lvl 1-2 his Wind Wall, Lvl 3 E+Q, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 2+ items his crit. The Level 6 claim is sound — R is 120/105/90s against a 70/50/30s Last Breath, so his ultimate is up far more often than yours and the page correctly treats 6 as a window rather than a takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that no Yasuo ability is ever named, and the pages call them 'his Q tornado', 'E-dash', 'R-knockup', and spell Wind Wall as 'Windwall' throughout. Wind Wall's duration and cooldown are never stated.
audit.why: Real names are Way of the Wanderer (P), Steel Tempest (Q), Wind Wall (W), Sweeping Blade (E), Last Breath (R). Wind Wall is 4 seconds of full projectile denial on 25/23/21/19/17s — the single number that decides when you are allowed to throw Q. Sweeping Blade is a 475-range dash that cannot be recast on the same target for a few seconds, which is why walking to a fresh minion beats chasing him.
audit.corrected: Named the abilities and put the real Wind Wall numbers (4s duration, 25s at rank 1, 17s at max) into the lines that gate your commits.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d calls a spent Wind Wall a 'fifteen-second invitation'. It is 25s at rank 1 and never shorter than 17s.
audit.why: enemyKit W: cd 25/23/21/19/17. Understating the punish window by ten seconds makes the player commit too early and lose the trade to a wall that is already back.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real 25s rank-1 figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every layer states that Wind Wall blocks Neeko's E (Tangle-Barbs) outright — tldr, whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0], early, mid, wants.foe[0].
audit.why: Neeko's Q carries the projectile flag, so Wind Wall blocking it is certain. Neeko's E carries only hardCC — no projectile flag — and Riot's text ('slings a tangle that damages and roots everything it passes through') does not settle it. Per the standing rule, empty means unknown, not no, and I will not assert or delete a spell-shield-class eligibility I cannot verify.
audit.corrected: Left every one of those strings untouched and raised it as a question instead.

edits.before: Yasuo burns Wind Wall on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yasuo burns Wind Wall on nothing — that is a 25s invitation at rank 1.

edits.before: His Windwall (W) blocks your E root and Q seed outright, and his dash closes your short range — he holds the level-2 edge.
edits.after: Wind Wall (W) eats your Q seed for 4 seconds, and Sweeping Blade (E) closes the gap — he holds the level-2 edge.

edits.before: Dash through the wave with E to dodge your telegraphed root and close his short-range gap
edits.after: Sweeping Blade (E) through the wave dodges your root and closes his 475-range gap on his terms

edits.before: Stack crit items and farm to 2+ items where his R-knockup all-in bursts your squishy body
edits.after: Stack crit and farm to 2+ items where Last Breath (R) off a knockup bursts your squishy body

edits.before: Yasuo's threat window: crit items + Windwall on a low cooldown let him block your combo and R-knockup off your minions to all-in your squishy body.
edits.after: Yasuo's threat window: crit items plus a 17s max-rank Wind Wall blank your combo, and Last Breath off any minion knockup all-ins your squishy body.

notes: Chart rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group; they now match both the packet and the page's own why text. diff was EVEN while every other difficulty signal on the page said 8/10 hard — moved to HARD. IMPORTANT unresolved: the entire page is built on 'Wind Wall blocks your E root'. Neeko's Q is flagged projectile so that half is certain, but Neeko's E has no projectile flag in the kit and Riot's text does not settle it. I left all seven of those strings exactly as they are rather than assert or remove an unverified block interaction — see questionsForUser. If E is in fact blocked, the page is already correct and nothing more is needed; if it is not, the whole matchup's advice is too conservative and needs a rewrite pass. Also unverified champion-wide: 'W invisibility' (whys[4], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[1]) — Riot's W text gives a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, no stealth flag.
